name: ecwid-redirect-404-helper-workspace
description: Dev workspace for the Redirect & 404 Helper for Ecwid WordPress plugin (wp-env local WordPress).

scripts.env:activate: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate ecwid-redirect-404-helper
scripts.env:deactivate: wp-env run cli wp plugin deactivate ecwid-redirect-404-helper
scripts.env:status: wp-env run cli wp plugin list
